findings.current: He was someone Wolhwa from the Lower District Sect’s Shanxi Branch had brought with her.
findings.defect: Wolhwa’s position as Shanxi Branch Leader is omitted, flattening the hierarchy that explains why the coachman she supplied cannot be ordinary.
findings.rationale: 산서지부장 explicitly identifies Wolhwa as the Shanxi Branch Leader, not merely someone affiliated with that branch.
findings.replacement: He was someone Wolhwa, the Lower District Sect’s Shanxi Branch Leader, had brought with her.

findings.current: The inside was about the size of an ordinary room, with plenty of space between the seats.
findings.defect: The draft changes the physical detail from the seats themselves being spacious to there being ample space between them.
findings.rationale: 좌석도 넓었다 describes the seats as roomy; it does not specifically describe the gaps between them.
findings.replacement: The inside was about the size of an ordinary room, and the seats were spacious too.
findings.source: 어지간한 방 하나 크기라 좌석도 넓었다.

findings.current: The carriage stopped two hours after that, around midnight.
findings.defect: The elapsed time is halved: two 시진 equal four modern hours, not two.
findings.rationale: A 시진 is a traditional double hour, so 두 시진 denotes approximately four hours.
findings.replacement: The carriage stopped four hours later, around midnight.
findings.source: 마차가 멈춘 것은 그로부터 두 시진이 지난 후, 자정 무렵이었다.

findings.current: He kept a close eye on Eight Spring Gorge from a distance of only two hours, and when he heard the result of the battle, he turned his horses around.
findings.defect: The distance is halved from four hours to two, and the leader’s singular horse is changed to multiple horses.
findings.rationale: 두 시진 is approximately four hours, while 말 머리를 돌렸죠 literally describes him turning his horse around.
findings.replacement: He kept a close eye on Eight Spring Gorge from only four hours away, then turned his horse around when he heard the outcome of the battle.
findings.source: 불과 두 시진 떨어진 거리에서 팔천협을 예의 주시하다가 전투 결과를 듣고 말 머리를 돌렸죠.

findings.current: “It’s a shrine that was abandoned after a famine several years ago, though it seems people from the nearby villages still come here from time to time.”
findings.defect: The draft replaces nearby commoners with people from nearby villages, adding a settlement detail and losing the social category later contrasted with hunters.
findings.rationale: 인근 양민들 means local or nearby commoners; it does not state that they come from villages.
findings.replacement: “It’s a shrine that was abandoned after a famine several years ago, though it seems local commoners still come here from time to time.”
findings.source: 수년 전 기근 이후로 버려진 사당인데, 지금도 간혹 인근 양민들이 오는 모양이에요.

findings.current: I had beaten them badly enough that they certainly needed treatment.
findings.defect: The draft sanitizes the narrator’s coarse, emphatic description of how thoroughly he demolished the bandits.
findings.rationale: 개박살을 내다 is strongly colloquial and vulgar, closer to beating someone to pieces or beating the shit out of them than merely beating them badly.
findings.replacement: I’d beaten the shit out of them, so of course they’d needed treatment.
findings.source: 그 정도로 개박살을 내 줬으니 치료가 필요하긴 했을 거다.

findings.current: “My goodness, look at me. I haven’t even properly introduced myself yet. I’m Wolhwa, Branch Leader of the Lower District Sect’s Shanxi Branch.”
findings.defect: “Look at me” is a literal calque that loses Wolhwa’s self-correcting social cue, and the established title is not rendered as Shanxi Branch Leader.
findings.rationale: 내 정신 좀 봐 is an idiomatic acknowledgment of her lapse in manners, while 산서지부장 has the established rendering “Shanxi Branch Leader.”
findings.replacement: “Where are my manners? I haven’t even properly introduced myself yet. I’m Wolhwa, Shanxi Branch Leader of the Lower District Sect.”
findings.source: 내 정신 좀 봐, 아직 정식으로 인사드린 적이 없네요. 하오문 산서지부장 월화라고 합니다.

findings.current: “A promising young master and a peerless beauty…… Ah, just looking at them makes my heart race. Don’t you agree?”
findings.defect: “Young master” can denote a noble heir and therefore obscures that 고수 praises Jin Mukyung as a highly skilled martial artist.
findings.rationale: 고수 is the established martial designation “master,” not the social title “Young Master.”
findings.replacement: “A promising young martial arts master and a peerless beauty… Whew, just looking at them makes my heart race. Don’t you agree?”
findings.source: 촉망받는 젊은 고수와 절세의 미녀라…… 크으, 보기만 해도 가슴이 뛰는군요. 안 그렇습니까?

findings.current: If there are thick-faced people like me, then there can be timid people too.
findings.defect: “Thick-faced” is an unnatural literal calque in contemporary English.
findings.rationale: 낯짝 두꺼운 describes someone unabashed or thick-skinned; “thick-skinned” preserves the comic contrast with 소심한 naturally.
findings.replacement: If there are thick-skinned guys like me, then there can be timid people too.
findings.source: 나처럼 낯짝 두꺼운 놈이 있으면 소심한 사람도 있는 거야.

summary: Two time quantities are halved, Wolhwa’s hierarchy is initially omitted, and several localized choices alter physical detail, social category, register, or martial terminology.
